# Final Project Presentations

Final-project presentations report an original data-science project. They are
different from topic presentations: a topic presentation teaches a method or
idea, while a final-project presentation explains a question, data, analysis,
evidence, limitations, and conclusions.

Each accepted presentation has its source in
`final/<project-name>/index.qmd`. The rendered deck is linked below after the
project is accepted.
